messages:
maya: Heads-up — multiple customers reporting the console shows a 3–5hr lag in usage graphs starting ~08:00 UTC. Noticed hourly rows missing for several tenants.
priya: Which customers? Any commonality (region/plan)?
maya: a handful — acme-co, devmetrics, and a couple of free-trial tenants. All in us-east-1. Not seeing increased error rates from the public API.
jen: I can see an alert for consumer lag on the usage-rollup consumer group around 08:05. infra-bot posted it.
infra-bot: ALERT: kafka.consumer.lag usage-rollup > 100000 (topic=tenant-usage-hourly) at 2024-05-04T08:07:03Z
jon: Copying logs. Rolling consumer restarts happened at 07:55 due to deploy. Might be a rebalance/backpressure.
priya: Customers are pinging support — some billing dashboards also show zeros. We should coordinate quick triage + customer comms.
terry: Repro steps I ran: Queried raw hourly table and saw a gap for rows with created_at between 07:00–10:00 UTC. Postgres shows writes backfilled later (11:00+).
jen: Can someone run this kafka consumer describe?
jen: ```
# on infra admin host
kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka.redwood.internal:9092 --group usage-rollup --describe
TOPIC                  PARTITION  CURRENT-OFFSET  LOG-END-OFFSET  LAG
tenant-usage-hourly    0          125000          230000          105000
tenant-usage-hourly    1          230000          230000          0
tenant-usage-hourly    2          229500          230000          500
```
jon: Partition 0 stuck huge lag. More messages being produced but group not keeping up. Partition skew during deploy is likely.
priya: Any errors in the consumer logs?
jen: Found repeated "invalid payload" exceptions during deserialization on worker-3 which processed partition 0. Stack: decoder -> usage-processor -> insert_rollup.
maya: That explains drop-through — consumers failed, messages sat in partition and got processed late when retry/worker restarted.
terry: Quick mitigation: we can trigger a manual backfill for affected time window while infra digests root cause. Backfill job id bf-171234-01 queued. Command I used: 
```bash
python infra/backfills/run_backfill.py --start 2024-05-04T07:00:00Z --end 2024-05-04T11:00:00Z --job-id bf-171234-01
```
priya: Great. Please link customers and ETA.
terry: Backfill kicked: https://ci.redwood.internal/job/bf-171234-01 (ETA ~40m for full rollup catch-up).
jon: For root cause, I dug into the consumer error — upstream CDC connector changed a field type (json->string) for optional meta.key which caused our avro deserializer to throw on some messages. It only hit partition 0 due to key hashing for a subset of tenants.
maya: So schema drift + rolling deploy = partitioned outage.
jen: Patch idea: make deserializer tolerant to that field (accept string or json) + add a schema-checker gate on connector config. I'll prepare PR.
priya: Customer comms: messaging to affected tenants: "We're backfilling missing usage rows now; dashboards should reflect data within ~45 minutes. We're investigating and will follow up with root cause." Can someone post to acme support ticket?
maya: I'll send.
jon: Short-term ops runbook:
- restart consumer worker-3 to clear bad state
- enable dead-letter routing for malformed payloads so they don't block group
- kick backfill job (done)
- monitor consumer lag and hourly rollup table write rate
jen: Implemented dead-letter routing on staging; will roll to prod after quick smoke. Created PR #3821 to make deserializer tolerant and to add connector schema check.
infra-bot: TASK: backfill bf-171234-01 succeeded (100%) at 2024-05-04T11:02:14Z.
support-bot: NOTE: Customer notifications sent to acme-co and devmetrics.
priya: Thanks all. Any long-term changes?
jon: Action items:
- merge PR #3821 (deserializer tolerance) — jon
- add connector schema validation to deploy checklist — jen
- add alert for single-partition lag > 30m — terry
- run a small reliab test for rolling deploys + connector schema change — maya
maya: I'll own postmortem and customer follow-up. Will draft a short incident note and timeline. Closing once PR merged + alert in place. :thumbsup:
